description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for performance testing Git fetch operations under various conditions, including handling large numbers of packs and refs to simulate pathological cases and measure fetch performance.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Sets up multiple pack files in the repository to simulate a large repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified description.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with a given description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
